title: CleanSheet v1.0.0 - Official Enterprise Release
changelog: Official Initial Enterprise Release of CleanSheet Studio
Complete Data Cleaning, Outlier Remediation, PII Masking & Fuzzy Merging
Smart String, Phone Normalizer (E.164) & Mixed Date Heuristic Parsers
Multi-Source SQL Connectors (SQLite, Postgres, MySQL) & REST API / JSON Flattening
Out-of-Core Big Data CSV Streaming Engine (500MB to 10GB+ support)
Password Encryption & Workbook Protection for Excel
Data Lineage Governance Audit Tracker & Executive PDF Certificates
